joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

gc_observation.clock: time.perf_counter host clock; align against raw measurement origin/end without altering raw timestamps
gc_observation.retained_events: All generation-2 collections and paired events lasting at least 0.001 seconds; this is logging detail, not a scheduling threshold.
gc_observation.short_event_accounting: per_generation aggregates cover the entire installation window; short events without individual timestamps cannot be exactly cropped to the raw measurement interval.
gc_observation.lifecycle: Record installation/uninstallation host time, GC enablement and thresholds; pair start/stop callbacks, retain pairing anomalies and pending_at_uninstall.
gc_observation.causal_limit: GC overlap is a common diagnostic, not a storage intervention in this group; callback intervals do not prove pure CPU pause cost or recovery-policy causation.

host_binding.source_and_cache_paths: Existing B source tree and HF paths retained.
host_binding.unchanged: Current GPU UUID,110GiB cgroup ceiling, host lock identity,2.5GiB prelaunch floor and strict empty-GPU boundary inherited from r05. Science model/input/output/GPUKV/HostKV16GiB settings remain fixed.
host_binding.prelaunch_requirement: Unchanged empty-GPU boundary must pass. Reported0MiB with100%utilization is not empty and is never ignored.

fixed.arrival_sequence: Same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals; every request completes1024 output tokens ignoring EOS.

fixed.admission: Original native fixedcap256, compiledmaxseq256; no adaptive admission
fixed.transfers: Native STORE/LOAD submission, flush dependency, ACK, buffers, references and physical release fences unchanged; ordinary donor preemption may add recomputation and Host save/load work, all counted
fixed.observations: Identical frozen stall8 receipts, compact capture/passive GC, existing tail allocator observer plus controlled failure latch and fresh exchange shadow in both arms. No extra CUDA queries or allocation/lookup calls.
fixed.recovery_actions: Frozen stall8 retains original8 successful-bypass budget and episode history. During a funded target protection window its existing guard pauses bypasses; no budget reset. Extra capacity exchange count is0/1, separate from those8 actions.

plan.scope: Controlled action-value diagnostic on a preselected development request. Not an online selector, independent confirmation, natural-EOS experiment, or a matched-state causal estimate.
plan.primary_readout: All256 arrivals per arm: maxgap mean/P99/max; mandatory TTFT/flow/throughput/drain, failed/timeout/unfinished and output/copy/repreemption/control costs. Target, donor and peers reported with full-service denominators; historical joint SLO diagnostic only.
plan.research_question: Can a fresh single-donor exchange after the known long request actually fails recovery allocation improve its full-request stall and the all-request tradeoff?
plan.only_changed_factor: Relative to r03: target and trigger only. Wait for the first observed async full-history allocation failure of b-normal-0070571-long, then attempt once at the immediately following rotation_begin with current object/episode/receipt and fresh donor/T/R/G state. Original Q1,16-entry fail-open,one donor,stall8,copy paths and workload unchanged.
plan.decision: No legal executed exchange: stop reverse cells and limit conclusion to this one boundary. Full-service harm/no valuable tradeoff: stop this long-target Q1 probe. Valuable tradeoff: only then design an ID-independent online selector and matched simple baseline; no threshold or Q sweep.

stage_budget.basis: Latest same-input four cells245–256s includinginit/warmup; expected1020s GPU.450s perchild/1800s summedchild budget,1800s lock wait. One group, no automatic retries; no fee/balance telemetry.

plan.stop_rule: After the first exchange_once, continue reverse cells only for one recorded successful native donor preemption; shadow decisions never qualify. Failed, timeout or inconsistent action cells remain recorded and abort without retries.

controlled_target.selection_basis: Largest long stall in prior development traces; chosen before this run. This privileged source-ID choice is a diagnostic and cannot enter any claimed deployable method.
controlled_target.trigger: First actual async allocation failure; fresh validation at immediately following begin; stale/changed evidence fails open.

storage_placement.reason: Authorized data filesystem below original floor; /tmp filesystem observed 4594266112B free at1791485763.0197115. Use identical private per-cell cache/output placement on /tmp, retain the original session-filesystem2.5GiB launch floor and public lock. No shared cache or other-line data removed.
storage_placement.scientific_comparison: Only the contemporaneous four cells are compared; r03 is not used as a performance baseline.

controlled_failure_trigger.scope: First real async allocation failure only; inspect once at the next native begin. Explicit development ID, not deployable selection. No stale donor snapshot, new lookup or second allocation.
